title: In Silico Identification of Key Genes and Immune Infiltration Characteristics in Epicardial Adipose Tissue from Patients with Coronary Artery Disease.
authors: Deng, Yisen; Wang, Xuming; Liu, Zhan; Lv, Xiaoshuo; Ma, Bo; Nie, Qiangqiang; Fan, Xueqiang; Yang, Yuguang; Ye, Zhidong; Liu, Peng; Wen, Jianyan
one_liner_zh: 该研究通过机器学习识别冠心病心外膜脂肪组织中的差异表达基因和免疫浸润特征，虽涉及基因表达分析，但未聚焦蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合机制，且无AI/物理模拟建模，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: BACKGROUND: The present study is aimed at identifying the differentially expressed genes (DEGs) and relevant biological processes and pathways associated with epicardial adipose tissue (EAT) from patients with coronary artery disease (CAD). We also explored potential biomarkers using two machine-learning algorithms and calculated the immune cell infiltration in EAT. MATERIALS AND METHODS: Three datasets (GSE120774, GSE64554, and GSE24425) were obtained from the Gene Expression Omnibus (GEO) database. The GSE120774 dataset was used to evaluate DEGs between EAT of CAD patients and the control group. Functional enrichment analyses were conducted to study associated biological functions and mechanisms using the Kyoto Encyclopedia of Genes and Genomes (KEGG), Gene Ontology (GO), and Gene Set Enrichment Analysis (GSEA). After this, the least absolute shrinkage and selection operator (LASSO) and support vector machine recursive feature elimination (SVM-RFE) were performed to identify the feature genes related to CAD. The expression level of the feature genes was validated in GSE64554 and GSE24425. Finally, we calculated the immune cell infiltration and evaluated the correlation between the feature genes and immune cells using CIBERSORT. RESULTS: We identified a total of 130 upregulated and 107 downregulated genes in GSE120774. Functional enrichment analysis revealed that DEGs are associated with several pathways, including the calcium signaling pathway, complement and coagulation cascades, ferroptosis, fluid shear stress and atherosclerosis, lipid and atherosclerosis, and regulation of lipolysis in adipocytes. TCF21, CDH19, XG, and NNAT were identified as feature genes and validated in the GSE64554 and GSE24425 datasets. Immune cell infiltration analysis showed plasma cells are significantly more numerous in EAT than in the control group (p = 0.001), whereas macrophage M0 (p = 0.024) and resting mast cells (p = 0.036) were significantly less numerous. TCF21, CDH19, XG, and NNAT were correlated with immune cells, including plasma cells, M0 macrophages, and resting mast cells. CONCLUSION: TCF21, CDH19, XG, and NNAT might serve as feature genes for CAD, providing new insights for future research on the pathogenesis of cardiovascular diseases.
abstract_zh: 背景：本研究旨在识别与冠状动脉疾病（CAD）患者心外膜脂肪组织（EAT）相关的差异表达基因（DEGs）及相关的生物学过程和通路。我们还利用两种机器学习算法探索了潜在生物标志物，并计算了EAT中的免疫细胞浸润。材料与方法：从基因表达综合（GEO）数据库获取了三个数据集（GSE120774、GSE64554和GSE24425）。使用GSE120774数据集评估CAD患者EAT与对照组之间的DEGs。通过京都基因与基因组百科全书（KEGG）、基因本体论（GO）和基因集富集分析（GSEA）进行功能富集分析，以研究相关的生物学功能和机制。随后，采用最小绝对收缩和选择算子（LASSO）及支持向量机递归特征消除（SVM-RFE）识别与CAD相关的特征基因。在GSE64554和GSE24425中验证了特征基因的表达水平。最后，使用CIBERSORT计算免疫细胞浸润，并评估特征基因与免疫细胞之间的相关性。结果：我们在GSE120774中鉴定出总共130个上调基因和107个下调基因。功能富集分析显示，DEGs与多个通路相关，包括钙信号通路、补体和凝血级联反应、铁死亡、流体剪切应力与动脉粥样硬化、脂质与动脉粥样硬化，以及脂肪细胞中脂解调节。TCF21、CDH19、XG和NNAT被确定为特征基因，并在GSE64554和GSE24425数据集中得到验证。免疫细胞浸润分析显示，EAT中浆细胞数量显著多于对照组（p = 0.001），而巨噬细胞M0（p = 0.024）和静息肥大细胞（p = 0.036）数量显著较少。TCF21、CDH19、XG和NNAT与免疫细胞（包括浆细胞、M0巨噬细胞和静息肥大细胞）相关。结论：TCF21、CDH19、XG和NNAT可能作为CAD的特征基因，为未来心血管疾病发病机制的研究提供新见解。
